topography.project_purpose: SuperFarm is a cross-chain DeFi protocol that enables users to stake assets and earn rewards, primarily through its native SUPER token and partner tokens. It provides staking pools and token infrastructure to facilitate yield generation and liquidity provision.
topography.relationship_narrative: The Staker contracts interact with the SUPER token and partner tokens like InjectiveToken and REVV to distribute rewards. The UniswapV2Pair likely provides liquidity for the SUPER token, supporting the staking ecosystem.
